title: Data Curation
definition: The process of collecting, organizing, and managing data to ensure its quality, relevance, and applicability for specific purposes.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Collecting and cleaning data like sorting and dusting your toys before playing with them. This ensures that the data is useful and doesn't have any errors or inconsistencies.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The process of acquiring, cleaning, and organizing data to ensure its quality, relevance, and applicability for machine learning tasks. This may involve tasks such as preprocessing, feature engineering, and labeling.
difficulty_levels.expert: Data curation is a crucial step in the machine learning process, as it ensures that the data used for training and evaluation is of high quality, relevant, and well-structured. This can involve tasks such as data cleaning, normalization, and balancing, as well as the creation of custom datasets for specific purposes.

extra_fields.insight: Data curation is essential for ensuring the quality and applicability of the data used in machine learning tasks, which directly impacts the performance and reliability of the resulting models.
